title: 65_HS1-834228961_62-HQ-83894_Section_2
doc_notes: This document is an FBI case file (62-HQ-83894) containing various reports and investigations into flying disc sightings and related claims from 1947. / This is an FBI case file containing various reports of flying discs and unidentified aerial objects, including statements from pilots and civilians.

encounters.summary: Two men observed a round, black object, 30-40 inches in diameter, moving horizontally at a steady rate without rays or exhaust.
A couple observed a ball of white light burning near the ground, leaving behind fused sand and metallic material.
A pilot and student observed a spherical object, estimated 30-50 feet in diameter, traveling at high speed and climbing rapidly.
Multiple witnesses observed groups of triangularly-formed illuminated objects flying over the city.
A woman and two children observed approximately two dozen round silver objects, platter-shaped, high in the sky.
Superintendent of Schools A. Courtney Parker observed a white, ball-shaped object followed by a saucer-shaped object moving noiselessly from the East.
encounters.location_name: Rix Ledges, north of Lebanon, N.H.
encounters.quote: I observed a so-called flying saucer.

encounters.summary: William Albert Rhodes observed an odd-shaped ship, 20-30 feet in diameter, making a spiral maneuver before banking into the clouds.
encounters.entity_appearance: dark, odd-shaped ship, 20-30 feet in diameter, green house in center
encounters.quote: I observed to the northeast what appeared to be an odd shaped ship.

encounters.summary: Chief of Police Leon V. Jenkins observed a bright metal object, similar to a weather balloon, traveling rapidly.
encounters.quote: an object similar in size to a weather balloon

encounters.summary: Mrs. G. H. Stockton and Hugh Jennings observed a football-shaped object turning end over end at constant altitude.
encounters.quote: object which he described as being shaped like football

encounters.summary: Fred M. Johnson observed a disc-shaped object with a tail, approximately 30 feet in diameter, while prospecting.
encounters.quote: saw a disc proceeding in a southeasterly direction.

encounters.summary: Kenneth Arnold observed nine disc-like objects flying in a chain-like formation near Mt. Rainier.
encounters.quote: I observed a chain of nine peculiar looking aircraft

encounters.summary: David N. Johnson observed a black, round object performing erratic maneuvers while flying an AT-6 aircraft.
encounters.quote: there suddenly appeared in the left hand portion of my field of vision an object which was black and round.

encounters.summary: Captain William H. Ryherd observed two shiny, ball-like objects traveling at high speed.
encounters.entity_appearance: solid, white, shiny, ball-like on bottom
encounters.quote: two flying objects traveling the same direction as the P-80.

encounters.summary: Lt. Eric B. Armstrong observed five or six white, circular objects flying in close formation.
encounters.quote: sighted five or six white, circular objects

encounters.summary: Captain Jack Peck and Vince Daly observed a smooth, streamlined object larger than a DC-3 crossing their course.
encounters.entity_appearance: smooth surfaced, streamlined, larger than DC-3
encounters.quote: sighted and followed a flying saucer Northwest of Bethel Alaska.

encounters.summary: Horace P. Wenyon observed a projectile-like object with spurting flames traveling at high speed.
encounters.quote: projectile approximately fifteen inches in diameter which crossed his course
